It was divided into two championships: the [[#Campeonato de Invierno|Invierno]] [winter] and [[#Campeonato de Verano|Verano]] [summer] seasons. The Invierno season was dedicated to Manuel Antonio "Pilo" Obando.{{cite web|last1=Coto|first1=Gerardo|title=Pilo Obando será inmortalizado en el Invierno|url=http://www.unafut.com/site/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=3743:pilo-obando-sera-inmortalizado-en-el-invierno&catid=9:noticias-historicas&Itemid=49|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140705020928/http://www.unafut.com/site/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=3743:pilo-obando-sera-inmortalizado-en-el-invierno&catid=9:noticias-historicas&Itemid=49|url-status=dead|archive-date=5 July 2014|website=UNAFUT.com|publisher=[[UNAFUT]]|access-date=31 July 2014}} ==Teams== The league was contested by a total of 12 teams, including [[AS Puma Generaleña|Puma Generaleña]], promoted from the 2013–14 Liga de Ascenso.
